content: Distribution for unpackaged self-contained WinUI3: PublishSingleFile (WinAppSDK 1.5+) produces one portable EXE, dependencies extract to temp on first run - matches 'just run the exe' model. Inno Setup remains the standard free choice when a proper installer (Start Menu shortcut, uninstaller, Add/Remove Programs entry) is wanted; it natively supports requesting elevation via PrivilegesRequired=admin. Velopack is the modern choice specifically for auto-updating desktop apps but is overkill/redundant here since the app already has a GitHub-asset self-heal pattern and predecessor precedent of manual portable-exe distribution.
